slides.title: Welcome to Prompt Engineering!
content: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial!
Learn the most important skill for using AI effectively.
Prompting: Giving specific instructions to AI.
Get high-quality results from any AI tool.
narration: Namaste and welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Prompt Engineering!
If you are not a coder, this is your single most important skill.
It is vital for effectively using Artificial Intelligence.
Think of an AI model like an incredibly smart and fast intern.
It can do amazing things, but it needs very specific instructions.
Prompting is the art and science of giving these instructions.
This helps you get the exact results you want from the AI.

slides.title: What is Prompt Engineering?
content: AI models are like smart interns.
They need clear, specific instructions.
Prompting is the art of giving these instructions.
Good prompts lead to great AI results.
narration: So, what exactly is Prompt Engineering?
Imagine you have a very smart intern who can do many things.
This intern needs clear and precise instructions to do the job perfectly.
Prompt engineering teaches you to give precise instructions to AI models.
It is about getting the AI to understand your request exactly.
This ensures it gives you exactly what you need.
slides.image_prompt: An animated, friendly intern character, possibly a cartoon person, sitting at a desk with a laptop, looking attentive and ready to work. A lightbulb appears above their head.

slides.title: The 3 C's: Clarity and Context
content: Clarity: Be specific, avoid vague words.
Weak: "Write about electric cars."
Clear: "Write a blog post on top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers."
Context: Provide background information (why, for whom, situation).
Example Context: "...for an environmental blog aiming to convince young urban professionals."
narration: A weak prompt gives a weak answer; a great prompt gives a great answer.
Best prompts use three key ingredients: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
First, let us talk about Clarity. This means being specific and avoiding vague words.
The AI doesn't know what you are thinking, so you need to be explicit.
For example, a weak prompt is, 'Write about electric cars.'
A clearer prompt would be: 'Write a blog post on the top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers.'
Now, let us move to the second C: Context.
Context means providing background information to the AI. Tell it the 'why', 'for whom', or the overall situation.
This helps the AI understand the purpose and tailor its response appropriately.
Building on our clear prompt, we can add context.
For example, we might specify: 'Write a blog post on the top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers, for an environmental blog aiming to convince young urban professionals to switch to EVs.'
This added context helps the AI understand the audience and the desired persuasive tone.
slides.image_prompt: A split image: Left side shows a magnifying glass on a vague, blurry text. Right side shows a clear, focused document with specific keywords. Below that, a thought bubble with a city skyline and a person reading a blog.

slides.title: The 3 C's: Constraints and Persona
content: Constraints: Set rules for length, format, and style.
Example: "Under 400 words, friendly tone, end with a question."
Persona: Tell the AI who to act as.
Example: "Act as an expert travel agent. Create a 5-day Rome itinerary."
narration: Third, Constraints: Set the rules.
These are boundaries that shape the AI's output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
Building on our electric car example, we can add specific constraints.
For instance, 'Write under 400 words, use a friendly tone.'
Also, 'End the output with a question.'
Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona.
slides.image_prompt: A split image: Left side shows a ruler and a pen on a notebook, illustrating setting limits. Right side shows a theatrical mask or an icon of a person wearing different hats (e.g., chef, doctor, teacher) to represent persona.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting: Talk to AI
content: Your first prompt is rarely the last.
Refine prompts based on AI's output.
Treat interaction like a conversation.
You: "Write a slogan for my coffee shop."
AI: "Brewing Happiness, One Cup at a Time."
You: "Make it shorter, more modern."
AI: "Urban Brews. Your Daily Grind."
narration: Once you have the basics, you can refine your prompts.
Iterative prompting means your first prompt is rarely your last.
The real skill is refining your prompts based on the AI's output.
Treat your interaction with AI like a conversation.
For example, you might ask, 'Write a slogan for my new coffee shop.'
The AI might reply, 'Brewing Happiness, One Cup at a Time.'
You can then refine this by saying, 'That's good, but make it shorter.'
Also, 'Can you make it more modern?'
The AI might then give you, 'Urban Brews. Your Daily Grind.'
slides.image_prompt: Two stylized speech bubbles showing a conversation flow. The first bubble has a question, the second an answer, then a refined question, and a refined answer. Use simple icons like a coffee cup.

slides.title: Key Takeaways
content: Always use Clarity, Context, and Constraints in your prompts.
Provide a Persona to guide the AI's role.

Use iterative prompting 
The conversational approach.
narration: Let us summarize what we have learned today.
Remember to always use Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Apply these when writing your prompts.
Don't forget to provide a Persona; it helps guide the AI's role.
And finally, use iterative prompting.
Treat it like a conversation to refine your answers.

slides.title: Your Assignment
content: Open an AI tool (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini).
Create a simple 3-day home workout plan.
Include a Persona (Fitness Coach), 3 C's (Clarity, Context, Constraints), and structured output (table format).

Prompt: "Act as a fitness coach. Create a simple 3-day workout plan for a beginner who wants to exercise at home with no equipment. The goal is a full-body workout. Present it in a table format with columns for 'Day', 'Exercise', and 'Duration'."
narration: Now it is your turn to practice.
Open up an AI tool like Google Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude.
Your assignment is to create a simple 3-day workout plan.
You need to combine a Persona, the 3 C's, and a structured output.
